notes: DiscoFlate v3.46.0 — the Chat tab speaks AS YOU: plain text (and #owner commands, everywhere they fire) posts through a per-channel webhook wearing your Owner name and Discord avatar, falling back to a 'Owner:'-prefixed bot post where Manage Webhooks isn't granted. Two invite links on the Discord tab: full (with Manage Webhooks) and a webhook-free one for cautious server admins. The Chat tab now reads the bot's live permissions in the scoped channel — Send disables with the missing permissions listed when the bot can't post, and the status line shows owner-voice/history availability. New Help section covers the Chat tab and granting Manage Webhooks on already-joined servers. Release APKs are now version-named (discoflate-vX.Y.Z.apk) so phone downloads stop piling up as 'discoflate (N).apk'.
